body:
Handoff from MMR-37 (runtime surface backend):
- **Re-installing on cold load.** A world's scene name is content-addressed: `mnbl_world_<content id 16>_<12 hex over encoder, template, extent>`. On a cold load, re-run `RuntimeWorldBackend.Prepare` + `Install` from the save's bundle; it reuses the installed folder when identical or reinstalls it under the same name.
  - An install in a new process removes other content-addressed folders the process has not used.
  - The engine's startup scene index keeps names of folders removed later, so `Construct`/`Resolve` require the folder to exist; install before constructing.
- **Native release.** It is recorded as called (`Scene.ClearAll`, renderer destruct, layer clear, camera release; ledgers in `evidence/runtime/world-surface.json`) but not measured. Measuring native reclamation on a world switch, and cold-load restore, are yours.
- **Generations.** Campaign map generations begin in `GeneratedMapScene.Load` and end in `Destroy`. A load in the same process requires the previous map destroyed first; `WorldGenerations.Begin` enforces this.
